activityHubBriefing.title: My briefing
activityHubBriefing.subtitle: Find recent reading, pick up your saved items and keep useful reference material close at hand.
activityHubBriefing.dayComparison: This visit is simulated. Content has a calendar date: the selection compares days without inferring a publication time.

activityHubBriefing.emptyNew: No unread content is dated after this day. Choose an earlier date or explore the feed.
activityHubBriefing.savedCopy: Up to two unread items saved during this visit.
activityHubBriefing.emptySaved: Your selection starts in the feed: save something to read and find it here.
activityHubBriefing.allSavedRead: All your available saved items have been opened. Find them in your selection.
activityHubBriefing.guidesCopy: Four signposts to understand a dossier and prepare the next step.
activityHubBriefing.emptyGuides: No guide is available in this selection.
activityHubBriefing.localNotice: The simulated date, reading and saved items belong to this visit. Opening content marks it as read; no sign-in tracking or real history is used.
